messages:
Maya: quick sync — we need to hand off the cloud catalog entitlement mapping for AWS/GCP/Azure to PMs + Legal. main items: SKU mapping, AMI / VM image IDs, payer entitlements, and the asset ownership matrix. who owns AWS seller registration right now?
Sam: I own the AWS seller registration. I need a canonical SKU list + final product package name to finish the billing bundle. can someone drop the current CSV? @Maya? :wave:
Maya: dropping the latest export below — it's missing a few AMI IDs and the GCP image paths. will update after this thread.```csv
sku,product_name,region,ami_id,gcp_image
RW-CORE-STD,Redwood Core - Std,us-west-2,ami-0a1b2c3d4e5f6,projects/redwood/global/images/rw-core-std
RW-CORE-PRO,Redwood Core - Pro,us-east-1,ami-0f1e2d3c4b5a6,projects/redwood/global/images/rw-core-pro
RW-EMBED-BASE,Redwood Embed - Base,us-west-2,,projects/redwood/global/images/rw-embed-base
```
Jordan: noted — missing AMI in RW-EMBED-BASE. I can bake the AMI and run the security scan but need the final container digest + base AMI we should use (al2 or ubuntu20). recommending al2 for consistent kernel patching.
Priya: legal heads-up — for AWS/GCP marketplace we need: publisher MSA signed, SOC2 or equivalent attestation pdf, export control checklist, and a short 1-paragraph customer-facing data residency statement. I can draft the MSA addendum but need the SKU list and which customers will be entitled to free trial offers.
Tom: for packaging/marketing — also need 3 screenshots (console listing), 1 short 30s demo video, and a test promo code for verification. can we standardize the trial to 14 days across clouds?
Maya: 14 days works. action items I propose: 1) Sam: finalize seller/billing IDs, 2) Jordan: bake AMIs + push digest, 3) Maya: produce canonical SKU CSV with regions & entitlements, 4) Priya: legal checklist + MSA draft, 5) Tom: listing assets (screenshots/video). I'll own the handoff doc and publish to shared S3.
Sam: confirmed. I'll attach seller IDs once I finish the AWS billing flow. ETA EOD PT.
Jordan: I'll start AMI bake tomorrow morning and post digests here. need confirmation: use AL2 base? @Maya please confirm.
Maya: yes AL2 for now. also add a note to include kernel args we tested in perf runs.
Priya: can you include the trial entitlement column in the CSV (trial_days) and who is eligible (enterprise, SMB)? I need that for the MSA addendum.
Maya: will add trial_days + eligibility. also adding a column for support_tier.
Marketplace Bot: Listing draft uploaded: s3://redwood-marketplace/drafts/1823450000/listing-draft.zip (access: partnerships@redwood.ai)
Tom: got the draft, will pull screenshots and assemble the 30s demo. can someone share a test tenant and API key for screenshots? @Sam or @Maya?
Sam: I'll provision a staging seller/test tenant and drop creds in 1password, will ping when ready.
Maya: timeline check — aiming to submit AWS/GCP this week, Azure early next week. if legal has blockers pushback, we may delay AWS by 48h. Priya acknowledge?
Priya: ack — I should have MSA/attestation doc + checklist by tomorrow noon PT. if anything shows up I'll flag immediately.
Maya: perfect. I'll update the handoff doc with owners + deadlines and tag you all. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Tom: thanks all — ping me if you want help with the demo script.
Sam: thanks, team.
Jordan: closing loop on this thread once AMI digests posted.
Maya: closing note: final owners: Sam (seller + billing), Jordan (images), Maya (SKU + handoff), Priya (legal), Tom (assets). last_message_ts=1823450300
